mode.title: Mode
mode.description: meetings = odds of a hike, hold or cut at each upcoming FOMC meeting. path = the average fed funds rate the market is paying for in each contract month. shift = how the implied path has moved since an earlier trade date.

tradeDate.title: Trade date (optional)
tradeDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty uses the newest published settlement report. Settlements publish after the close, so during the session the previous day is the newest available.

compareDaysBack.title: Compare against days ago
compareDaysBack.description: Shift mode. How many days back to compare against. The exchange keeps only about the last week of settlement reports, so beyond that there is nothing to compare with.

includeThinContracts.title: Include thinly traded contracts
includeThinContracts.description: Off by default. Far dated months can carry a few hundred lots against hundreds of thousands in the front months, and a rate implied by almost no trading is not a market view worth quoting as one.

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: The first 2 rows of every run are free.
